title: rc.3 PC checklists (owner decision 60A, 2026-11-28)
format: rows: each must be seen (min, default 1) for PASS; {"any": [...]} passes on any one. count: shown, never judged. never: one line FAILs. rate: FAILs above max_per_hour. near: FAILs when a b line's point is within `within` of an earlier a line's point for the same join field. in_game: what only the screen can settle (no rows at all: IN GAME). also: the rest of the pass rule, for a reader. Field conditions: exact text, re:<regex> (searched), >n >=n <n <=n, a..b (inclusive).
